title: Wire atmosphere heuristic to knowledge-studio route
description: Sidebar.tsx declares atmosphere:"heuristic" for /dashboard/knowledge-studio but AtmosphereProvider maps that route to "memory". The olive heuristic tone exists in globals.css but is never applied.

classification.rationale: Classified as SIMPLE complexity. Direct delegation: single domain, no cross-cutting impact. Required agents (4): backend, frontend, qa, memory_engineer.
